metadata.description: A spellbook of AI skills for Claude Code — engineering docs, per-service AWS cost attribution and management-ready cost reports.

plugins.name: engineering-docs
plugins.description: Write the engineering documents nobody wants to start from a blank page — product requirements docs, blameless root cause analyses, and operational runbooks. Each skill interviews you for what is missing, mines the repo and git history for what it can answer itself, and writes a finished Markdown document.

plugins.name: aws-cost-audit
plugins.description: Work out where an AWS bill actually goes — down to the job, the cluster and the notebook that caused it — and write it up for whoever has to act on it. The Glue deep dive attributes DPU-hours to individual jobs and reconciles them against the bill, recovering runs from CloudTrail and CloudWatch Logs where jobs were deleted; the SageMaker deep dive attributes Studio spend to spaces, their owners and the notebooks that ran; the report skill turns a period of Cost Explorer data into a management-ready .docx with per-service root causes, recommendations by time horizon and clickable Cost Explorer evidence. Each ships a deidentified example of its own output. Standalone sweep scripts for idle and orphaned resources and S3 lifecycle gaps are included, plus a least-privilege IAM role. Every AWS call is read-only.
